text:
nina: Quick ask — we have a short launch push for LATAM next week. Need a compact asset bundle: hero (web), 3 social tiles, one 16:9 explainer slide, and two short GIF promos. Locales: ES-ES + PT-BR. Deadline: 36h.

oliver: On it. Do we need full translation for speaker blurbs or just headlines/descriptions?

nina: Headlines and social captions translated. Speaker blurbs in EN only for now. Also need localized CTA: ES: "Reservar plaza"; PT: "Reserve sua vaga". UTM: utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic, utm_campaign=latam-launch-2026.

manu: Creative specs:
- Hero: 1600x900 (web) + 1200x628 (link preview)
- Social: 1080x1080, 1080x1350, 1200x630
- GIFs: 800x450 & 600x600, 5s loop, under 2.5MB preferred
- Slide: 1920x1080 export + PNG thumbnail 1280x720
- Source: Figma + PNGs + WebM for motion

designbot: Export checklist:
```
- Provide 1x + 2x PNGs for hero and social
- WebM for GIF motion with fallback GIF under 2.5MB
- Include alt-text lines and 2 colorways (default + high-contrast)
- File naming: LATAM_2026_<locale>_<asset>_v1.png
```

ops: For lead routing: if country in [BR,AR,CL,MX] set lead.queue = queue_latam; if country=BR set lead.language=pt-BR else set lead.language=es-ES. Add tag lead.campaign = "latam-launch-2026". Capture timezone_pref where available.

nina: Legal note: avoid unverified performance claims on hero. Manu, include small source footnote area on explainer slide for any metrics.

legal: Confirming — translations must include privacy consent line in local language. Send final copy to legal for signoff before export.

oliver: I'll draft ES/PT captions (short/long) and push to thread by EOD. Manu will push mock PNGs in ~9h.

manu: Pushing first-pass assets to Figma dev link: https://figma.com/file/latam_dev/launch. Naming preview files and adding a README with final delivery folder: marketing-assets/launches/latam-2026 and tag `launch/latam/march`.

nina: Thanks—once assets are uploaded I'll run a quick signup test and verify UTM/lead routing. :rocket:
